_metadata.description: OT-P0-005 — baseline-aware validation: compute the exact check set, run on request, verify DoD.

requirements.title: Compute the exact baseline/validation command set from connected code
requirements.description: From a plan's connected code, derive the precise set of baseline/validation commands needed across all affected locations (not just scenarios) — so the agent does not have to reason about which scenarios to baseline.

validation.notes: Connected code maps to deduplicated scenario baseline commands and repo diff locations.

requirements.title: Run validation on request and verify DoD against the regression anchor
requirements.description: On request (agent in the loop) the scenario runs the computed checks and returns results + staleness, and verifies Definition-of-Done against the regression anchor as an oracle rather than relying on a narrated claim. Agents may run baselines; they never commit.

validation.notes: Validation verdicts derive from command runner outcomes without false passes.
Definition-of-done verification derives a baseline oracle from connected code references.

requirements.title: Validate relevant-context commands and references
requirements.description: Validation checks structured relevant-context setup items so command/search instructions are current and doc/code/requirement reference targets do not silently point at missing context.

validation.notes: Command and search relevant-context items are validated through CLI Health.
Doc/code/requirement relevant-context targets resolve through the reference resolver and missing targets fail validation.
Unavailable reference resolution reports UNKNOWN instead of fabricating a pass.
